stem:
Brenda is putting candy into gift bags.

• She has 165 pieces of candy.

• Each gift bag will have exactly 12 pieces of candy.

How many gift bags can Brenda make with the candy that she has?

Complete the sentences by selecting the correct answers from the drop-down menus.

Brenda can make a maximum of [blank_1] gift bags.

In this situation, the remainder represents the number of pieces of candy [blank_2].
